resume: Dark drone firmware based on GR!MM: four tracks, a 64-step sequencer, chords and an arpeggiator, with the Holvut source (a screaming feedback loop) and a DRONE page that evolves on its own.

commandes.role: Octave down. In the save menus, steps back.
Octave up. In the save menus, confirms.
Opens SCALE then CHORD; held then released, turns the track's chord mode on or off.
Opens the LFO pages; pressed twice, opens DRONE (BORGA, STOARBMA, GOHCCAT).
Opens the arpeggiator; held, turns it on or off for the track.
Opens the 64-step grid then the pattern settings; SELECT moves the cursor.
When stopped, each key writes its note into the selected step; during playback, what you play lands on the nearest step.
On HOME, the tempo; on the sequencer, moves the cursor.
Loads the next or previous sound in the selected track; on the sequencer, sets the tempo.
Selects the working track, T1 to T4.
Play the selected track; the keyboard is shifted down one octave, starting at F 2.

modes.texte: Six presets (POLAR HOWL, WENDIGO, FROZEN SCREAM, WHITEOUT, DEAD SIGNAL, ICE WRAITH) hold their notes in LATCH; ICE WRAITH is the startup sound.

a_savoir: No samples are supplied: the four slots are to be filled from the editor.
Saves are separate from those of GR!MM: you start again with empty projects.
